names.name: The hand-lettered board
names.said: Prices in marker, taped over the last prices.

text.what: The menu written by hand — on card, on a whiteboard, on the glass — and updated by writing over it.
text.story:
*Inference —* a hand-lettered board is the tell of a shop that changes what it sells faster than it can order signage: the egg rolls, the boba, the burrito and the kolache arrive on card taped beneath the printed donut list. This project reads boards this way; it is not a cited finding.

The printed panel above usually carries what the shop has always sold, and the card below carries what is keeping it open.
text.today: The board is where a directory should look first for what a shop actually does now.

kin.as: What tends to be written on the card.
The shops it is found in.
